should_flag.rationale: New money-moving POST (refund + fee debit) has no @idempotent; a client retry would refund and debit twice (ADR-004).
should_flag.expected_fix: Decorate refund_remaining_with_fee with @idempotent, like create_refund above it.

should_flag.rationale: Builds its own httpx.Client instead of the shared client, losing retries, request-id propagation and http_call metrics (ADR-006).
Reads the wall clock directly (and naive utcnow); tests can't freeze it via frozen_clock.
Fee is computed on the original charge amount, but the refund is only the remaining refundable amount; partially refunded charges are overcharged.
should_flag.expected_fix: Base the fee on the refunded amount: _processing_fee(refund.amount_cents) (i.e. charge.refundable_cents).

should_not_flag.trap: Percentage fee on integers risks rounding errors; use Decimal for currency arithmetic.
should_not_flag.reject_reason: Money is int minor units since ADR-007, and apply_bps already rounds half-even. No Decimal.

should_not_flag.trap: Add a docstring to _processing_fee explaining the fee rule and minimum.
should_not_flag.reject_reason: It's a private helper and the name says what it does; we only docstring public service functions.

should_not_flag.reject_reason: We don't type tests, mypy excludes tests/ anyway.
